text: Aflac Incorporated's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 identifies Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. (ALIJ; アフラック生命保険株式会社) as the primary insurance subsidiary of its Aflac Japan reporting segment, and the 10-K's Exhibit 21 lists Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. as a subsidiary of Aflac Holdings LLC (Nebraska), itself a subsidiary of Aflac Incorporated.
short: Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. is a subsidiary of NYSE-listed Aflac Incorporated (via Aflac Holdings LLC).

source.name: Aflac Incorporated: Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, Item 1 'Business' (SEC EDGAR, filed 2026-02-25)
source.quote: The primary insurance subsidiary in the Aflac Japan segment is Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. (ALIJ)
